purpose: Every forecast variant tried or decided, so results can be judged against the number of choices made (Man AHL, Jane Street; PBO by Bailey et al.). Runs with a report feed scripts/claims_pbo.py.
fixed_before_any_fit: target: any new locator-day in a previously staked section in calendar year Y
event unit: distinct claimant-and-date, not claim count
training labels up to Y-2; test years 2003-2023; 5 township folds
features: trailing 1y and 3y staking decisions, active claims, township activity, gold within radius, distance to gold
model: logistic regression; baselines: climatology, per-cell trailing rate, year base rate (oracle)

history.change: first full run (no recalibration, claimant names upper-cased only)
